paite: Itna delh zel unla, khalam thilpiakte leng lunggulh gige un, himahleh thu na gentheihna ding uh lunggulh sem un.
heading: Thugentheihna Leh Pautuamte Thilpiak

paite: Pautuamte a pau in mi kiang a thugen hilou in Pathian kiang a gen ahi zaw hi, kuamah in athugen athei kei a; himahleh kha ah thuguk agen ahi.
Thugenmi in bel mihing kiang ah bawlhoihna thute, hanthawnna thute, khamuanna thute agen zaw zel hi.
Pautuamte a pau in amah kia akibawlhoih a, thugenmi'n saptuamte abawlhoih zaw hi.

Huan na vek un pautuamte a na pau uh ka hon deihsak a, himahleh thu na gen uh ka hon deihsak sem hi; saptuamte'n kibawlhoihna amuhtheihna ding un ahilhchet nawn keileh thugenmi zaw pautuamte a pau mi sang in athupizaw hi.
Tu in unaute aw, na lak uah kilakna hiam, theihna hiam, thugen hiam, sinsakna hiam toh hong lou a, pautuamte a thu gen in hong pai leng, nou a ding in bang ka phatuam dia?
Thil hinna nei lou, gingtheite leng, tamngai hiam, kaihging hiam, gen nei a agin keileh, bang la ahia atum ua akaih uh bangchi in atheihtheih dia?
Gen nei lou a pengkul amut un kua galkap ding in akisa dia?
Huchi mah bang in nou leng pau theih baihlam a na gen kei uleh bang thu ahia na gen uh bangchi in atheihtheih dia? Huihkhua a pau lel na hi kei ding ua hia?
Khovel ah pau chi tuamtuam tampi a-om tham a, himahleh gen nei lou himhim a-om kei hi.
Apau in bang gen ahia chih ka theih keileh a genmi a ding in kei melmak ka hi ding a; a genmi leng kei a ding in melmak ahi ding.
Huchi in noute'n khalam thilpiakte na lunggulh mah bang un saptuam bawlhoihna ding in theihtawp suah in zang un.
Huaiziak in pautuamte a thu gen in ahilhchet theihna ding in thum hen.
Pautuamte a ka thumleh ka kha in zaw athum ngei a, ka theihna bel aphatuam tuan kei hi.
Bangchi in ahita dia le? Kha in ka thum dia, theihna in leng ka thum ding; kha in la ka sa dia, theihna in leng la ka sa ding hi.
Hichi lou in, Kha in vualzawl mah lechin athei nailoute'n na thugen theiloupi in na kipahthugen uh bangchi in Amen, achi thei ding ua?
Nang zaw chihtak in kipahthu na gen hoih a, midang abawlhoih tuan kei hi.
Noumau tengteng sang in pautuamte a thu ka gen tam zawk ziak in Pathian kiang ah kipahthu ka gen hi;
Himahleh saptuamte kikhopna ah pautuamte a thu singkhat gen sang in midangte ka hilhtheihna ding in ka theihtheihna in thumal nga kia gen ka utzaw ahi.
Unaute aw, ngaihtuahna ah naupang kei un; himahleh gilou ah zaw naungek unla, lungsim ah piching un.
Dan laibu ah: "Pautuamte leh gamdang mite muk in, hiai mite kiang ah thu ka gen ding a; huchi in leng ahon ngaikhe tuan kei ding uh, Toupa'n achi," chih gelh ahi.
Huaiziak in pautuamte zaw gingtate a ding in chiamtehna ahi kei a, gingloute a ding in ahi zaw, thugen bel gingloute a ding in chiamtehna ahi kei a, gingtate a ding in ahi zaw hi.
Huaiziak in saptuam tengteng kikhawm a na vek ua pautuamte a na pau uleh thei nailoute leh gingloute hong lut leh ahai uh hon chi kei ding ua hiam?
Na vek ua thu na gen uleh ging lou hiam, thei nai lou hiam hong lutleh asiamlouhdan uh na vek ua ma ah hihlat ahi ding;
huchi in alungtang thugukte uh hihlat in a-omta ding a, lei si in Pathian abe ding ua, "Pathian na lak uah a-om taktak," chih agen ding uhi.
Unaute aw, bangchi ding ahita dia le? Na hong kikhop un, phatna la hiam, thu kihilh hiam, theihsakna thu hiam, pautuamte, hilhchetna hiam na nei chiat zel ua. Bangkim bawlhoihna ding in hih hi hen.
heading: Saptuam Biakna Dan Ding

paite: Kuapeuh in pautuamte a thu agen uleh, nih in hiam, atampen in thum in hiam hileh, kikhel zel in leng hi hen.
Huan mi khat in hilhchian hen; hilhchianmi a-om keileh saptuamte kikhopna ah dai in om henla, amah leh Pathian kiang ah gen hen.
Thugenmi in leng nih in hiam, thum in hiam, gen uhenla, midangte'n hoihtak in ngaihtuah uhen.
Himahleh akiang a tu midang kiang a theihsakna thupiak ahong tunleh amasa pen dai mai hen.
Mi tengteng in atheihtheihna ding leh mi tengteng khamuang a a-omtheihna ding un, na vek un khatkhat in thu na gen thei ngal ua.
Thugen mite, khate thugen mite thuthu in a-om uh ahi.
Pathian zaw buaina Pathian ahi kei a, lemna Pathian ahi zaw hi. Mi Siangthou saptuam pawl tengteng a-om bang in,
Saptuamte kikhopna ah numeite dai dinden in om uhen; amau zaw athugen uh phal ahi kei a; Dan gen bang in thumang in om zaw uhen.
Huan bangpeuh atheihnop uleh inn ah amau pasalte dong uhen; saptuamte kikhopna a numei thugen zaw azumhuai hi.
Pathian thu noumau a pan pawt ahi maw? Ahihkeileh noumau kiang kia ahong tung ahi maw?
Kuapeuh thugenmi hiam khami hiam akisakleh na kiang ua ka gelh Toupa thupiak ahi chih atheih ding ahi.
Himahleh kuapeuh in atheih keileh amah leng theih ahi kei hi.
Huaiziak in unaute aw, thugen lunggulh unla, pautuamte a thugen leng kham kei un;
Himahleh bangkim kilawm leh diktak a hih hi hen.
